task_description: Write a method in Dafny to put spaces between words starting with capital letters in a given string.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method InsertSpacesBeforeCapitals(s: string) returns (v: string)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The output string contains all characters from the input string with additional spaces inserted before each uppercase letter that is not at the beginning of the string
- The order of characters in the output string corresponds to the input string with the specified modifications
- No other characters are altered or removed
